_comment: Full-regression runs shown in the portal's 'Regression automation test' section.
Newest run FIRST - the portal renders runs[0] by default and offers the rest in a picker.
Column meaning (see the team reporting standard):
passed   = green on the first attempt, PLUS any deferred skip that the round-2
DeferredVerify job later confirmed CORRECT (e.g. TC.THD_3.2.2.5.2).
failed   = still red after all 3 Playwright attempts (retries: 2).
flaky    = red then green on a retry.
skipBug  = test.skip carrying a [CRM-####] tag, i.e. blocked by a known open bug.
Never executed - this is debt, not a result.
skipOther= skipped with NO [CRM-####] tag - reason not yet established. Kept as its own
column so every row still sums to specs instead of silently losing rows.
deferFail= deferred skip that round-2 found STILL WRONG. Always list the specs
under deferFails so the reader sees WHAT was wrong, not just a count.
To add a run: prepend an object to 'runs'. No HTML editing required.
